title: Kiln Serving Benchmark Server Launch v1
description: Owned-server launch contract for a local serving benchmark. It records an argv vector, working and log directories, readiness cadence, bounded startup and shutdown, and acceptable exit statuses; hardware names in an instance ID are evidence labels, never runtime dispatch policy.

schema.description: Schema identifier for this launch contract.

id.description: Stable, path-safe identifier for this launch recipe. It may name the evidence environment but does not control backend routing.

command.description: Executable and arguments passed directly as an argv vector, without shell evaluation. The executable must resolve to an explicit absolute or relative path.

items.description: One nonempty argv element; index zero is the executable and later elements are its arguments.

working_directory.description: Directory from which the owned server process is launched. A relative path is resolved from the launch-contract directory.

log_directory.description: Directory reserved for this owned server's captured logs. A relative path is resolved from the launch-contract directory.

readiness_poll_interval_ms.description: Delay in milliseconds between `/v1/models` readiness probes while the owned server is starting.

startup_timeout_seconds.description: Positive wall-clock deadline for the owned server to remain alive and answer the readiness probe.

shutdown_timeout_seconds.description: Positive wall-clock deadline for the owned process group to exit after graceful shutdown begins, before forced termination is considered a failure.

acceptable_exit_codes.description: Sorted, unique process exit statuses accepted after a fully verified graceful shutdown. A listed status does not excuse forced termination or surviving child processes.

items.description: One integer process exit status accepted for this server implementation.
